{{Top|leg}}
A '''holoplatform''' was a device used for advertizment in the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]].

==History==
Holoplatforms measuring 10 or 20 kilometers across orbited selected planets, showcasing commercials all day and night.
A commentator boasted that on half of the Sector's planets, one couldn't see the stars due to the sky being covered by such platforms.
